name: cut_list_says_whether_it_compared
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding L16-8. drawing_cut_list looked for the quantity column ONLY by the name of the property («QUANTITY»), and IWeldmentCutListAnnotation~GetColumnCustomProperty.html warns: «This method returns an empty string if the column is not a user-defined column». With a table template whose QTY is a column of quantity TYPE (swWeldTableColumnType_Quantity = 402) the comparison with the cut list of the part was skipped, and the answer was a success with a sentence at the bottom. Now the column is looked for first by type (ITableAnnotation.GetColumnType2), then by name, and the answer SAYS how it found it and whether the comparison was made.
defect_caught: The comparison silently skipped, on the STANDARD table template of SOLIDWORKS («cut list.sldwldtbt» of the installation, English language, which is in every installation). The first draft of this case used the default template of the options (empty «template»), which on this machine is the workshop's: there the QTY is a property and was already found by name (`cut_list_in_the_drawing` is green on 0.136.0 with `quantity_in_table` 4), so the case was red on the old library only for the new field that was missing, and the search by type was proved by nobody (review of Z-C21.2). On the standard template the QTY is a type column, not user-defined: on the old library the column is not found, `quantity_in_table` and `match` are missing and the case is red on three lines; on the new one it is found by type.
_to_check_on_the_first_run: NOT MEASURED -- that in the standard template the QTY really is a column of type 402 and that GetColumnCustomProperty gives it empty are said by the guide and the name of the type, not by a reading. If at the first run `quantity_column_found_by` comes out «name», the standard template has the QTY as a property and this case does not prove the search by type: that must be said in the entry, not the expectation corrected.

expect.why: THE LINE THAT PROVES L16-8: the QTY column of the standard template found by TYPE (402), not by the name of the property, which is empty here
the quantity column found and the comparison with the cut-list folders of the part really made
on the old library it is missing: the column was not found and nothing was summed
four bars on the sheet, four bodies in the cut-list folders
